options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name of the group (via aria-labelledby).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial wall-clock time; also the value restored by reset(). Millisecond must be 0; second must be 0 at minute granularity.

options.name: min
options.description: Earliest allowed time (inclusive); first suggestion. Must not be after max.

options.name: max
options.description: Latest allowed time (inclusive); last possible suggestion.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name for the hidden input (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: An empty entry is invalid; segments are required and the required indicator is shown.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables segments and the button; not submitted.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable and submitted; not editable and the listbox does not open.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation after built-in checks; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: hourCycle
options.description: 12- or 24-hour entry and display; 'auto' follows the locale.

options.name: step
options.description: Minutes between suggested times (integer 1..720). Does not constrain typed values.

options.name: locale
options.description: Segment order, hour cycle (auto), day periods, option labels, and messages.

options.name: direction
options.description: Listbox alignment direction (applied when the listbox opens).

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: group
properties.description: The labelled role=group; control boundary and popup anchor.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value; null when empty, incomplete, or failing a built-in check.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value, or a partial entry exists.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic value (no events); clears an external custom error.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options. Throws CFG_INIT_ONLY when granularity changes.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show the listbox and focus it; the option nearest the value (or the first) becomes active.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Hide the listbox without changing the value; focus inside it returns to the button.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: HH:MM (HH:MM:SS at second granularity), or null.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close, remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the value or its validity (typing, stepping, or choosing a suggestion).

cssClasses.name: aui-time-picker__group
cssClasses.description: Labelled group; control boundary and popup anchor.

cssClasses.name: aui-time-picker__fields
cssClasses.description: LTR-isolated run of segments and separators.

cssClasses.name: aui-time-picker__option
cssClasses.description: Suggested time; --active marks the active descendant.

cssClasses.name: aui-time-picker__empty
cssClasses.description: Shown when no suggestion fits between min and max.
